text:
Priya Shah: FYI — FinRegCo (POC) just asked if we can guarantee EU-only processing for the entire request lifecycle (inference, embeddings, logs, backups). They also want to know: subprocessor list for EU, routing policy for sessions that originate outside EU, and any pricing uplift for region-pinning. Need quick answers for their SOW tonight.

Jon Keller: Short answer: yes for Dedicated and Private. For Hosted we can offer EU-only tenancy for enrolled enterprise customers but it’s conditional (contract + capacity).

Marta Lopez: Clarifying q: when they say "EU-only", do they mean no cross-border backups and no logs leaving EU? That changes compliance wording.

Priya Shah: They mean everything stays in EU — inference, model KV cache, logs, backups. They also want to confirm subprocessors (cloud + logging) and an explicit routing policy that prevents fallbacks to non-EU regions.

Evan Li: Technical notes: for Dedicated/Private we can pin tenant to region(s) and set fallback_policy to DENY. For Hosted we have an "EU-hosted" tenancy which pins inference & storage to eu-west-1 / eu-central-1. Edge case: 3rd-party model artifact fetches during onboarding may hit provider endpoints — we can vendor-lock artifacts into EU buckets.

Evan Li: Example tenant config we can apply for the POC (ops will run):
```json
{"region_pin":"eu","allowed_regions":["eu-west-1","eu-central-1"],"fallback_policy":"deny","kv_storage":"eu-only","log_retention_region":"eu"}
```

Priya Shah: Can you also enumerate subprocessors we need to disclose? list + locations + SOC/ISO certs ideally. FinRegCo asked for a short table.

Evan Li: Subprocessor quick list (EU footprint): AWS (eu-west-1, eu-central-1) - compute & object storage; GCP (europe-west4) - optional for multi-region; LogStream (eu-west-1) - logging pipeline; Metrics: Datadog EU2; Backup vault: VaultCo (Frankfurt). All have ISO27001 / SOC2 (links available).

Jon Keller: Pricing note for sales: region pinning + reserved capacity increases unit price roughly ~15-25% depending on capacity commit (main drivers: dedicated GPU reservation and EU egress/backups). For a POC (1 month, small capacity) we can offer a temporary credit or reduce uplift to ~10% — recommend quoting both hosted-EU and Dedicated-Pin options in the SOW.

Priya Shah: @Jon — can you draft the two pricing bullets? I’ll include in SOW.

Jon Keller: Draft: 1) Hosted EU tenancy (no region fallback): base hosted rates + 15% regional premium, per-token billing. 2) Dedicated tenant-pin (reserved GPUs): committed monthly price (min 1 node) + maintenance fee; effective per-token ~25% higher but predictable latency & no cross-border egress. I’ll add concrete numbers after ops confirms capacity.

Marta Lopez: Legal check — I need to review the subprocessor list and copy of contracts. @LegalBot can you fetch the standard subprocessor disclosure and EU-hosting clause?

LegalBot: Pulling template — https://redwood.internal/legal/subprocessors/eu-hosting-template.md : contains clause + checklist. Also flag: add explicit noconnect fallback clause if they require absolutely no non-EU fallback.

Priya Shah: Ops, can you run through the exact steps to apply the tenant pin for the POC and any limitations? We need this in the SOW (runbook).

ops-bot: Ops runbook snippet:
1) Provision Dedicated pool in eu-central-1
2) Create tenant finregco with region_pin=eu, fallback_policy=deny
3) Replicate model artifacts to eu object storage
4) Configure logging endpoint to LogStream EU and set retention to 90d
5) Verify e2e: inference request -> EU GPU -> EU logs -> no outbound calls to non-EU

ops-bot: CLI example: redwoodctl tenant update --id finregco --region-pin eu --fallback-policy deny --kv-storage eu-only

Evan Li: Two caveats to call out in SOW: 1) If customer requests pin to multiple EU regions for HA, cross-region replication for kv/backups will stay in EU but is still cross-border within EU (okay for them?). 2) Third-party model provider endpoints must be vendor-contained — we recommend vendor artifact ingestion into our EU buckets to avoid any external egress during serving.

Priya Shah: Great. Action items: Jon to draft pricing bullets + numbers after ops confirms capacity and cost. Marta/Legal to produce subprocessor table + cert links. Ops to provide runbook and ETA for artifact replication. Evan to confirm any model-specific caveats. I’ll update the SOW and send to FinRegCo.

Jon Keller: I’ll have a draft pricing line by EOD.

Marta Lopez: I’ll send subprocessor export by tomorrow morning.

Evan Li: I’ll validate artifact replication process and post estimated time (30-90 mins once bucket access granted).

Priya Shah: Thanks all :thumbsup: — tagging FinRegCo briefing for transparency.
